policy: Only actively maintained tools are listed. Archived repos are removed on the next pass; repos without a push in 365+ days are flagged watch.

retired.reason: Last pushed 2024-09 — stagnant for over a year; replaced the slot with actively-maintained alternatives.
Last pushed VeNoMouS/cloudscraper — no longer in the 'actively maintained' tier (>365d no push).
Last pushed 2025-07, no longer in the 'actively maintained' tier. Replaced by nodriver from the same author.
Archived non-official mirror. Pointed at the official BeautifulSoup docs site instead.

tools.name: Playwright
tools.desc_en: Cross-browser automation for Chromium, Firefox & WebKit — one API for tests, scraping and screenshots.
tools.desc_zh: 跨浏览器自动化：一套 API 覆盖 Chromium / Firefox / WebKit，用于测试、爬取、截图。
tools.why_en: One API across all three engines — write once, run everywhere.
tools.why_zh: 一套 API 通吃三种浏览器内核——写一次，处处能跑。
tools.install: pip install playwright / npm i playwright

tools.name: Puppeteer
tools.desc_en: Node API to control Chrome/Chromium with a high-level, ergonomic surface.
tools.desc_zh: Node 库，以高层、顺手的 API 控制 Chrome / Chromium。
tools.why_en: The de-facto standard browser driver for Node — huge community & cookbooks.
tools.why_zh: Node 社区事实标准的浏览器驱动，教程与示例极多。

tools.name: Selenium
tools.desc_en: The classic cross-browser automation suite, battle-tested for years.
tools.desc_zh: 经多年实战检验的经典跨浏览器自动化套件。
tools.why_en: Works across old & new browsers — most mature ecosystem.
tools.why_zh: 一套工具兼容新旧浏览器，生态最成熟。

tools.name: Browserless
tools.desc_en: Self-host headless Chrome as an API service with concurrency & metrics.
tools.desc_zh: 把无头 Chrome 自托管为一个 API 服务，自带并发与监控。
tools.why_en: Scale many scraping jobs per browser without managing pools.
tools.why_zh: 一台浏览器并发跑大量爬取任务，不用自管浏览器池。

tools.name: Chromedp
tools.desc_en: Drive headless Chrome from Go via the DevTools Protocol — fast and dependency-free.
tools.desc_zh: 在 Go 中通过 DevTools 协议驱动无头 Chrome——快速且零依赖。
tools.why_en: Pure Go, zero external deps — fast for concurrent scraping.
tools.why_zh: 纯 Go、零外部依赖，适合并发爬取。

tools.name: DrissionPage
tools.desc_en: Drive Chromium and raw requests sessions through one unified API, switching between them freely; strong anti-detection, hugely popular in the Chinese dev community.
tools.desc_zh: 一套 API 同时驱动浏览器（Chromium）与 requests 会话并自由切换，反检测能力强，中文社区非常活跃的大杀器。
tools.why_en: Mix browser power and raw-request speed in one workflow, with cookies/logins carried across both.
tools.why_zh: 浏览器与人肉 request 混着用，登录态互通，不用重复登录。

tools.name: nodriver
tools.desc_en: Successor to undetected-chromedriver from the same author: drives Chrome/Edge over the raw DevTools Protocol — no Selenium layer, fewer fingerprinting artifacts.
tools.desc_zh: undetected-chromedriver（同作者）的正统继任者：直接基于 DevTools 协议驱动 Chrome/Edge，不再依赖 Selenium，指纹痕迹更少。
tools.why_en: Stays invisible to basic anti-bot without patching binaries or maintaining a patched driver.
tools.why_zh: 不用补丁、不用维护改版驱动，就能过基础反爬检测。

tools.name: Camoufox
tools.desc_en: Open-source anti-detect Firefox fork tuned for stealth scraping & AI agents.
tools.desc_zh: 面向隐形爬取与 AI 助手的开源反检测 Firefox 分支。
tools.why_en: Look like a real user to anti-bot systems — no manual hardening.
tools.why_zh: 在反爬系统眼里"像真人用户"，无需自己加固浏览器。

tools.name: browser-use
tools.desc_en: AI agent framework — an LLM (GPT, Claude, DeepSeek, ...) drives a real browser to complete tasks autonomously: navigate, click, type, extract.
tools.desc_zh: 让 LLM（GPT / Claude / DeepSeek 等）自己操作真实浏览器完成任务：自动导航、点击、输入、提取。
tools.why_en: Point an LLM at a goal and it operates the browser end-to-end — write goals, not selectors.
tools.why_zh: 你给目标、它自己操作浏览器——写目标，不用写选择器。

tools.name: Stagehand
tools.desc_en: AI browser automation built on Playwright — natural-language act / extract / observe primitives.
tools.desc_zh: 基于 Playwright 的 AI 浏览器自动化框架：用自然语言完成操作 / 提取 / 观察。
tools.why_en: One extract() call replaces fragile CSS/XPath selectors that break with every redesign.
tools.why_zh: 一句 extract() 顶掉一打一改版就碎的 CSS/XPath 选择器。

tools.name: Skyvern
tools.desc_en: Open-source vision-based browser agent (LLM + computer vision) that fills forms and executes end-to-end flows on ever-changing layouts.
tools.desc_zh: 视觉智能体（LLM + 计算机视觉）：自动填表、跑通端到端任务，专治布局天天变的页面。
tools.why_en: It 'sees' the page like a human — no brittle selectors to maintain at all.
tools.why_zh: 它像人一样"看"页面——完全没有脆弱的 CSS 选择器要维护。

tools.name: curl_cffi
tools.desc_en: Python binding to curl that impersonates browser TLS/JA3/HTTP2 fingerprints to pass anti-bot checks.
tools.desc_zh: Python 库，模拟浏览器 TLS/JA3/HTTP2 指纹以通过反爬校验。
tools.why_en: Fix "blocked for no reason" — pass TLS fingerprint checks on many sites.
tools.why_zh: 修复"莫名其妙被封"——通过很多网站的 TLS 指纹校验。

tools.name: httpx
tools.desc_en: Modern async-capable Python HTTP client with HTTP/2 — core to most scrapers.
tools.desc_zh: 现代异步 Python HTTP 客户端，支持 HTTP/2，多数爬虫的核心依赖。
tools.why_en: Fast concurrent requests — no threading boilerplate.
tools.why_zh: 快速并发请求，不用写一堆多线程样板代码。

tools.name: FlareSolverr
tools.desc_en: Proxy server that clears Cloudflare & DDoS-GUARD using a real browser.
tools.desc_zh: 用真实浏览器组件代理，绕开 Cloudflare 与 DDoS-GUARD 防护。
tools.why_en: Auto-solve Cloudflare challenges — no manual clicking per request.
tools.why_zh: 自动过 Cloudflare 挑战，不用每次手动点。

tools.name: buster
tools.desc_en: Browser extension that solves CAPTCHAs via reCAPTCHA audio challenges.
tools.desc_zh: 浏览器扩展，通过 reCAPTCHA 音频挑战自动解答验证码。
tools.why_en: Skip human CAPTCHA checks during manual or light scraping.
tools.why_zh: 手动/轻量爬取时，跳过人工验证码。

tools.name: Scrapy
tools.desc_en: High-level Python scraping framework with pipelines, schedulers and exporters.
tools.desc_zh: 高层 Python 爬取框架，自带管道、调度与导出。
tools.why_en: One framework for crawl + extract + export at scale.
tools.why_zh: 一个框架搞定"爬取 + 解析 + 导出"，可规模化。

tools.name: botasaurus
tools.desc_en: Scraping framework with built-in anti-detection, proxy rotation, task scheduling and a GUI for debugging jobs.
tools.desc_zh: 自带反检测、代理轮换、任务调度与图形界面调试的爬虫框架。
tools.why_en: Battle-tested anti-detect defaults plus a ready-made UI to watch jobs live.
tools.why_zh: 出厂自带久经考验的反检测配置，还能开着网页实时盯任务。

tools.name: BeautifulSoup4
tools.desc_en: Friendly Python HTML/XML parser for fast extraction.
tools.desc_zh: 友好的 Python HTML/XML 解析库，快速提取。
tools.why_en: Beginner-friendly parsing — no regex or heavy XPath needed.
tools.why_zh: 新手友好解析，不用正则也不用 XPath。

tools.name: parsel
tools.desc_en: Scrapy's selector engine, standalone — CSS, XPath and regex extraction in one small API.
tools.desc_zh: Scrapy 同款选择器引擎（独立版）：CSS / XPath / 正则一体解析。
tools.why_en: Write selectors once, reuse them in plain scripts or inside Scrapy.
tools.why_zh: 选好选择器写法，普通脚本和 Scrapy 里都能复用。

tools.name: lxml
tools.desc_en: Industrial-grade C-accelerated HTML/XML parsing and XPath engine.
tools.desc_zh: 工业级 C 加速 HTML/XML 解析与 XPath 引擎。
tools.why_en: The fast, robust backbone most other Python parsers build on.
tools.why_zh: 又快又稳的底层引擎，很多解析库都建立在它之上。

tools.name: selectolax
tools.desc_en: Cython HTML5 parser built on the Lexbor engine — CSS-selector speed far beyond lxml/BeautifulSoup.
tools.desc_zh: 基于 Lexbor 引擎的 Cython HTML5 解析器，CSS 选择器速度远超 lxml / BeautifulSoup。
tools.why_en: Parsing-heavy jobs run several times faster with the same familiar CSS API.
tools.why_zh: 同样的 CSS 语法，解析密集型任务快好几倍。

tools.name: trafilatura
tools.desc_en: Extracts clean main text, title and date from raw HTML — strips navigation and ads, built for corpora and research.
tools.desc_zh: 从 HTML 自动抽取干净的正文 / 标题 / 日期，去掉导航与广告噪音，专为语料与研究设计。
tools.why_en: Raw page → article-ready text in one function call.
tools.why_zh: 一个函数调用，网页变可用正文。

tools.name: ProxyPool
tools.desc_en: Python spider proxy IP pool with scheduled collection, validation & RESTful API.
tools.desc_zh: 定时采集、校验、提供 RESTful API 的爬虫代理 IP 池。
tools.why_en: One command to a fresh pool of working proxies.
tools.why_zh: 一条命令拿到一批可用的新代理。

tools.name: scrapy-rotating-proxies
tools.desc_en: Scrapy middleware to rotate proxies, check liveness & tune crawl speed.
tools.desc_zh: Scrapy 中间件：轮换代理、检测存活、调节爬取速度。
tools.why_en: Avoid IP blocks on large crawls — rotate automatically.
tools.why_zh: 大规模爬取自动轮换代理 IP，避免被封。

tools.name: jq
tools.desc_en: Command-line JSON processor — slice & filter scraped JSON.
tools.desc_zh: 命令行 JSON 处理机器——切片、过滤抓到的 JSON。
tools.why_en: Turn messy JSON into clean CSV with one command.
tools.why_zh: 一条命令把乱七八糟的 JSON 变成干净 CSV。
tools.install: brew install jq / apt install jq

tools.name: CSVKit
tools.desc_en: Swiss-army knife of CSV tools to convert, filter, analyze & clean.
tools.desc_zh: CSV 瑞士军刀：转换、过滤、分析、清洗一条龙。
tools.why_en: Convert JSON/Excel to CSV in one line — no code.
tools.why_zh: 一行命令把 JSON/Excel 转成 CSV——不用写代码。

tools.name: Miller
tools.desc_en: awk/sed for name-indexed data; converts CSV/JSON/TSV.
tools.desc_zh: 面向带列名数据的 awk/sed；支持 CSV/JSON/TSV 互转。
tools.why_en: Filter & reshape large datasets without writing scripts.
tools.why_zh: 不写脚本也能过滤、重塑大数据集。

tools.name: DuckDB
tools.desc_en: In-process columnar analytics database — query CSV/JSON/Parquet files directly with SQL, zero import.
tools.desc_zh: 进程内列式分析数据库：一条 SQL 直接查 CSV / JSON / Parquet，无需导入。
tools.why_en: Ad-hoc analytics on scraped dumps without writing a single load script.
tools.why_zh: 爬下来的数据直接开查，一行导入代码都不用写。

tools.name: csvs-to-sqlite
tools.desc_en: Convert one or many CSV/TSV into a SQLite database.
tools.desc_zh: 把一个或多个 CSV/TSV 转为 SQLite 数据库。
tools.why_en: Go from CSV to a queryable DB in one command.
tools.why_zh: 一条命令把 CSV 变成可查询的数据库。

tools.name: SQLite-Utils
tools.desc_en: CLI + Python utility for SQLite; import CSV/JSON, build APIs quickly.
tools.desc_zh: 命令行 + Python 工具：操作 SQLite，快速导入 CSV/JSON、搭建接口。
tools.why_en: Turn scraped files into a local API — no server needed.
tools.why_zh: 把抓到的文件变成本地接口，不用起服务器。

tools.name: Datasette
tools.desc_en: Turn a SQLite database into a browsable website and read-only JSON API in one command.
tools.desc_zh: 一条命令把 SQLite 数据库变成可浏览的网站 + 只读 JSON API。
tools.why_en: Share a scraped dataset as a URL instead of a file.
tools.why_zh: 把爬取结果用一个网址分享出去，而不是发文件。

tools.name: visidata
tools.desc_en: A spreadsheet in your terminal — browse, slice & reshape million-row dumps in seconds.
tools.desc_zh: 终端里的电子表格：几秒浏览、切片、重塑百万行 CSV/JSON。
tools.why_en: Explore data before deciding what to ship — no Jupyter needed.
tools.why_zh: 先肉眼过一遍数据再决定怎么用，不用开 Jupyter。

tools.name: XlsxWriter
tools.desc_en: Python library for writing Excel .xlsx with formulas & charts.
tools.desc_zh: Python 库，写出带公式与图表的 Excel .xlsx。
tools.why_en: Generate polished Excel reports from scraped data.
tools.why_zh: 把爬到的数据生成漂亮的 Excel 报表。

tools.name: Apache Superset
tools.desc_en: Modern BI & exploration platform with rich export.
tools.desc_zh: 现代 BI 与数据探索平台，支持丰富导出。
tools.why_en: Dashboard your scraped data & export to many formats.
tools.why_zh: 把爬到的数据显示成看板，并导出多种格式。

tools.name: pandas
tools.desc_en: Core Python data analysis library with CSV/Excel export.
tools.desc_zh: 核心 Python 数据分析库，支持 CSV/Excel 导出。
tools.why_en: Clean, join & export data at scale in one library.
tools.why_zh: 一个库搞定清洗、合并、导出大量数据。

tools.name: Scrapling
tools.desc_en: All-in-one modern web scraping framework — plain HTTP, headless browsers and anti-detection in a single API.
tools.desc_zh: 新一代一体化爬虫框架：普通 HTTP 请求、无头浏览器与反检测集成在同一套 API 里。
tools.why_en: The best of requests + Playwright + anti-bot evasion in one import.
tools.why_zh: 一个 import 就集成了 requests + Playwright + 反机器人绕过，全场景覆盖。

tools.name: Crawl4AI
tools.desc_en: AI-powered web crawler & extractor — turns any page into clean, LLM-ready structured data.
tools.desc_zh: AI 驱动的网页爬取与提取：把任意页面变成干净、可直接喂给大模型的结构化数据。
tools.why_en: Fast, browser-based crawling with LLM-friendly output — the 2026 standard for AI pipelines.
tools.why_zh: 基于浏览器的快速抓取 + 大模型友好输出，是 2026 年 AI 数据管线的标配。

tools.name: Crawlee
tools.desc_en: Node.js web scraping & browser automation library — Cheerio, Puppeteer, Playwright & browser pools under one API.
tools.desc_zh: Node.js 爬虫与浏览器自动化库：Cheerio / Puppeteer / Playwright 和浏览器池统一在一套 API 下。
tools.why_en: The mature JS-companion to Scrapy-style scraping — scaling and retries built in.
tools.why_zh: 成熟的 JS 版对应物，自带队列、重试与代理轮换，补齐清单里的 Node 生态缺口。
